text:
maya: FYI ran surge-sim against node sampleapp, saw duplicate webhook deliveries when API returned 429. repros reliably with short auth TTL.

linus: likely the token-rotate + immediate retry race. did we get Retry-After?

maya: no Retry-After for these responses. trace shows SDK retried while auth refresh completed -> two in-flight attempts.

sam: stopgap: add Idempotency-Key header in sampleapp for side-effect endpoints. long-term: SDK should avoid sending a retry during token swap.

joel: agree on header format: `Idempotency-Key: <action>:<user>:<uuid>` so infra can correlate.

linus: proposal for SDK: attach an auth-stamp to the request and before retry check if current stamp changed; if changed, wait a jittered backoff then re-evaluate. keeps unsafe replays down.

maya: also respect `Retry-After` when present; otherwise use full-jitter exponential backoff. sampleapp will implement both.

sam: telemetry: emit `dup_side_effect_detected` when server returns `x-idempotency-hit` or when we detect repeated keys. will add dashboard card.

joel: action items: linus -> prototype auth-stamp in node SDK; maya -> patch sampleapp to add Idempotency-Key + jittered backoff; sam -> telemetry/dashboard; run surge-sim e2e after PRs.
